meta.description: Erasmus+ Croatia knowledge graph: institutions, organisations, projects, sectors, locations and aggregate statistics.
notes: Beneficiaries linked to a register are the Institution node; the others are Organisation nodes (merged by normalised name + postal code, or place when no postal code).
Project.amount_eur is the sum of National Agency grant lines; RECEIVED_GRANT.amount_eur is per line.
ka2_total_grant_eur is the whole KA2 project grant, not the Croatian share.
KA2 projects also in the National Agency list are merged into one Project node.
Registers contain no personal contact data; Founder nodes keep the register text as given.

Concept nodes (Problem, TargetGroup, Approach, Output) are extracted from KA2 summaries with curated regex vocabularies (rule-based, English only); Topic nodes come from the EU 'Topics' column. A missing edge means 'not detected', not 'absent'. CO_OCCURS and ADDRESSED_BY are aggregated (PMI over projects with a summary).
